thread:
Asha - PMM: Quick ask: can we produce a very concise one-page 'Secure Inference Playbook' for field + a tiny appendix? Need: security summary, SLA language (non-binding for hosted), deploy decision flow, two benchmark blurbs (latency & cost), and an inbound routing form.
Diego - Growth: Yes. My ask: keep social-friendly lines we can reuse (1 tweet, 1 LinkedIn). Also want a single benchmark chart for promo.
Maya - Solutions Eng: We should avoid absolute latency promises for hosted. Proposed phrasing: "Typical baselines (p50/p95) observed on Dedicated in standard configs; consult appendix for measured samples."
Riley - Field: Add an immediate triage cheat: tags for inbound form -> "Gov/Regulated", "On-prem", "Pilot", "Support SLA". Routing rules: Gov/Regulated & On-prem -> enterprise-ops; Pilot -> AE; others -> growth-nurture.
Nora - Design: I'll mock a single-sheet with three panels: Why security matters, How we commit (SLA + baselines), How to choose a deployment. Need copy by Thursday noon to mock variants.
Asha - PMM: Draft copy (short bullets):
- Headline: "Secure inference at every scale: Hosted, Dedicated, Private."
- Security snapshot: SOC2 Type II, customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, logging & audit exports, optional on-prem airgapped bundle.
- SLA snapshot: Dedicated: contractual uptime + latency SLOs; Hosted: operational baselines and upgrade paths. See appendix for numbers.
Maya - Solutions Eng: For appendix samples (not on the main sheet) I can provide two callouts:
1) Chat production (8k context window, redwood-7b-v1): p50 ~ 90ms, p95 ~ 340ms on Dedicated (A100 config).
2) High-volume embeddings (batch=512): throughput ~ 40k embeddings/hr, cost/unit ~ $0.0007 with caching and int8 quantization.
(Include caveat: numbers vary by model, region, and sequence length.)
Diego - Growth: For the webinar, short format: 25-min talk + 15-min live Q&A. Title option: "Operational inference: secure, fast, and cost-savvy." CTA = download one-pager + appendix.
Riley - Field: Also include 2-3 quick buyer lines for compliance questions: "We support KMS/HSM, audit export, and on-prem deployments for regulated workloads. FedRAMP/GovCloud routing via enterprise sales."
Asha - PMM: Quick example SLA snippet we can show (label as example):
```
Example (Dedicated): 99.95% uptime SLA, defined latency SLO targets per model class.
Example (Hosted): Operational baselines published; enterprise SLAs available on Dedicated.
```
Nora - Design: For the CTA form, what fields? Suggest: company, name, email, region, workload type (chat/embeddings/other), compliance needs (checkbox), pilot timeline (checkbox), notes. Also add hidden field for routing tags.
Diego - Growth: Social copies:
- Tweet: "New: Secure Inference Playbook for enterprises — SLAs, deployment guidance, and benchmarks. Register for the quick webinar."
- LinkedIn: longer paragraph + benchmark image + link to landing with form.
Maya - Solutions Eng: Appendix should also have 2 tiny CLI snippets for the field to demo fallback behavior and latency test:
```
# run a latency test against Dedicated
rwctl test latency --model redwood-7b-v1 --tokens 512 --runs 100
# fetch deployment status
rwctl deploy status --name customer-dedicated
```
Riley - Field: Routing rules to ops: if region==us-gov OR mentions FedRAMP/DoD/HIPAA -> tag enterprise-ops; if checkbox On-prem==true -> enterprise-ops; pilot==true -> AE; else -> growth-nurture.
Asha - PMM: Action items:
- Maya: paste appendix numbers + CLI snippets (tomorrow)
- Nora: first one-pager mock (Thursday noon)
- Diego: draft webinar landing + social blurbs (Thursday)
- Riley: coordinate routing rules with inbound ops (next week)
content-bot: Created draft resource -> https://redwood.internal/marketing/secure-inference-playbook-draft (edit access).
Diego - Growth: I'll prepare the promo calendar and a 3-line webinar blurb.
Nora - Design: I'll include an alternate header option: "Predictable inference, built for compliance."
Asha - PMM: Keep language tight. Field should be able to drop the one-pager into an email. If we ship the one pager + appendix + landing form, we can align the webinar and socials next week. Thanks everyone :)
